During filming 𝟖 𝐌𝐢𝐥𝐞 (𝟐𝟎𝟎𝟐), Eminem was reportedly romantically linked to both Brittany Murphy and Kim Basinger. Brittany later confirmed that she and Eminem briefly dated after meeting on set, though he never publicly commented on the relationship.⁣
 ⁣
Years later, Brittany Murphy tragically died at just 32 years old from pneumonia, with severe anemia and multiple prescription medications listed as contributing factors. Her sudden passing shocked the world, and the mystery deepened when her husband, Simon Monjack, died only five months later in the very same house from pneumonia and anemia, fueling years of speculation and conspiracy theories. Following Murphy’s death, Eminem paid tribute by including a dedication to her in the booklet of his 2010 album Recovery, writing: “In memory of Brittany Murphy (1977–2009).”
